categoryName: Home furnishing — bedsheets, blankets, quilts, pillows, towels, curtains, mats, mattress protectors (cold climate)

skuLines.line: Single bedsheet — mass cotton/glace print, 60x90 with 1 pillow cover
skuLines.examples: BSB HOME 160 TC printed single, Rajat/Geeta Presents 160 TC single, Story@Home single bedsheet, local Panipat/Erode mill print
skuLines.packSizes: 1 flat sheet 60x90 in + 1 pillow cover; sold single-piece and in 2-pack bundles
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 180-450 (Amazon.in Aug-2026: min 188, median 279, p75 385)
skuLines.seasonality: Huge spike at hostel intake (Mar-Apr and Jul); steady replacement year-round
skuLines.notes: The single highest-velocity furnishing line in a residential-school township — hostel beds are 3x6 ft. Buy in one dominant size, not many. Light and stackable, so it is the cheapest thing per rupee to freight up the hill. Keep 3-4 dark/printed designs that hide wear; white shows dust on hill roads.

skuLines.line: Single bedsheet — premium 200-300 TC pure cotton / percale
skuLines.examples: Spaces Bedsheets Single (Welspun), Swayam 200 TC pure cotton, Story@Home 210 TC, Trance/Loreto cotton
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 700-1,700 (Spaces/Swayam catalogues Aug-2026: p10 899, median ~1,049-1,499)
skuLines.seasonality: Gifting and Diwali; term-start upgrades
skuLines.notes: Keep depth shallow — 4-6 designs. Per-piece value crosses the GST slab threshold on some of these; the made-up-textile threshold was re-cut in the 2025 rationalisation, so confirm the current cut-off before fixing shelf price.

skuLines.line: Double/king bedsheet + 2 pillow covers — mass glace cotton 160-200 TC
skuLines.examples: BSB HOME 200 TC double, RajasthaniKart pure cotton double, Queenie double, Swayam Bedsheet Set
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 230-600 (Amazon median 379); Rs 899-2,039 for Swayam/Story@Home branded
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Diwali and wedding-season gifting spike Oct-Dec
skuLines.notes: Staff-quarter workhorse. Married-quarter beds are 5x6.5 or 6x6.5 ft — stock both 'double' and 'king' cuts; a wrong-size sheet is the most common return in this category.

skuLines.line: Double bedsheet — premium 210-400 TC cotton / satin
skuLines.examples: Spaces Bedsheets Double & Large (210 TC Hygro), Swayam 300 TC, Stoa Paris 300 TC satin, Trance Home Linen
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 1,700-4,500 (Spaces catalogue: p25 1,999, median 2,950, p90 7,199)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali, weddings, guest-room refresh
skuLines.notes: The one place a township store can hold a genuinely aspirational price point — senior staff and faculty families otherwise spend this money on a trip to Solan/Chandigarh. Slow-turning: 6-10 SKUs maximum.

skuLines.line: Fitted (all-round elastic) bedsheet — single and double
skuLines.examples: DECORUM glace fitted single 72x36, la'amour fitted single, Home Sizzler 210 TC fitted, Spaces Fitted Queen/King
skuLines.packSizes: Fitted sheet + 1-2 pillow covers; skirt drop 8-10 in
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 210-500 mass (Amazon median 312); Rs 1,250-2,000 branded (Spaces/Swayam p25 1,249, median 1,619)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; intake spike
skuLines.notes: Fastest-growing shape in Indian bedding — 345 of 4,156 SKUs across four live catalogues, and Spaces now runs 'Fitted Queen'/'Fitted King' as their own product types. Ideal for hostels: it does not come off a thin foam mattress at night, which cuts laundry churn.

skuLines.line: Plain white / solid institutional bedsheet — bulk
skuLines.examples: Mill-made 200 TC plain white 90x100, Solapur plain solids, Trident/Panipat institutional packs
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 200-450 per piece in bale quantity
skuLines.seasonality: Function/convocation and guest-house season; new-hostel-block fit-outs
skuLines.notes: The Trust's own hostels, guest houses, langar hall and sangat functions need plain whites in volume. Carry this as an indent/bulk line with a quoted rate card rather than shelf stock — it is where a township store either captures institutional spend or watches it go to Chandigarh wholesalers.

skuLines.line: Kids print bedsheet — single, cartoon/character
skuLines.examples: RD FABS cartoon glace cotton 60x90, Loreto kids cotton, Story@Home kids, Swayam Kids Bedsheet
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 190-600 (Amazon median 399)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake months; birthdays
skuLines.notes: Junior-wing children (5-11) and married-staff toddlers. Licensed-character prints carry no licence risk for the retailer but do carry higher cost; unlicensed 'cartoon' prints from Panipat are the margin play.

skuLines.line: Pillow covers / pillowcases — pairs and packs, standard and king
skuLines.examples: BSB HOME king pillow covers pair, Swayam 200 TC pillow cover pack, Story@Home 2-pc, Spaces pillow covers
skuLines.packSizes: Pack of 2, 4 and 6; 17x27 in standard, 20x30 in king
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 100-400 per pair mass; Rs 500-1,000 branded pack
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Covers wear out 3x faster than the sheet — highest-repeat, lowest-shelf-space item in the whole lane. Never let it stock out; it is the classic 'wallet leaks to town' purchase.

skuLines.line: Bedspread / day bed cover and diwan set
skuLines.examples: Swayam Diwan Set (5/8-pc), Story@Home bedcover, cotton chadar bedspread, jacquard bedcover
skuLines.packSizes: Single/double bedspread; diwan set = 1 sheet + 2 bolster covers + 5 cushion covers
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 400-1,000 bedspread; Rs 1,270-2,500 diwan set (Swayam median 2,159)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali, weddings, new-quarter allotment
skuLines.notes: Diwan/baithak seating is standard in staff quarters and guest rooms; the cover set is what makes a hostel-issue diwan presentable. Slow but high ticket.

skuLines.line: Quilt cover / razai khol / duvet cover with zip
skuLines.examples: Trance Home Linen zippered 300 TC single, Satin stripe rajai cover, Spaces Duvet Cover Double, local stitched khol
skuLines.packSizes: Single 60x90, double 90x100; with zip or tie closure
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-1,000 mass (Amazon median 783); Rs 1,900-3,200 branded (Spaces duvet median 3,199)
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp Sep-Nov peak as quilts come out of storage
skuLines.notes: In a cold township this is a bigger seller than the quilt itself: a razai is bought once in five years, its khol is washed and replaced yearly. Stock in the same two sizes as your quilts so the pair sells together.

skuLines.line: Bedding bundle / 'bed in a bag' hostel admission pack
skuLines.examples: BSB HOME AC comforter gift set with bag, 4-pc comforter set double, Spaces Bed in a Bag, Swayam Bed in a Bag
skuLines.packSizes: 4-8 pieces: sheet + pillow(s) + cover(s) + blanket/comforter, in a carry bag
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 1,300-4,000 mass (Amazon median 1,749); Rs 5,400-10,000 branded (Spaces p25 6,309)
skuLines.seasonality: Admission weeks (Mar-Apr, Jul) — 80% of annual volume in ~6 weeks
skuLines.notes: Build your own pack from bulk components instead of buying branded sets — a store-assembled 'hostel kit' at a fixed price is the single highest-value merchandising move in this lane, and it converts a parent's anxious first-day shopping list into one bill. 62 branded 'bed in a bag' SKUs exist, all priced above what a self-assembled kit costs.

skuLines.line: Mink blanket — single and double, 400-600 GSM embossed
skuLines.examples: BSB HOME mink double 1.9 kg, Goyal's 500 TC mink double, VAS Collections mink 1500 g, SANMARINO Korean-style 525 GSM
skuLines.packSizes: Single 60x90 in / ~1.5 kg; double 220x240 cm / 2-3.5 kg
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 400-1,000 single; Rs 600-1,700 double (Amazon: min 385, cluster 599-1,639, premium to 2,499)
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb; buy Aug-Sep, first sell-through by mid-Oct
skuLines.notes: The volume warmth SKU at ~1,400 m altitude. Two-ply/heavy 500+ GSM sells in the hill belt where 300 GSM sells in the plains. Bulky and light — blankets cube out a truck before they hit its weight limit, so freight per rupee of stock is the worst in the category: consolidate one big pre-winter inward, not weekly top-ups.

skuLines.line: Woollen / Solapur blanket — single, heavy winter
skuLines.examples: VAS Collections woollen heavy single, BSB HOME 300 GSM woollen single, Solapur chaddar-blanket, Ludhiana mill woollen
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-1,300 (Amazon: min 299, p25 499, median 1,098)
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb; Trust winter-seva distribution can move a bale at a time
skuLines.notes: The institutional and elderly favourite — washes hard, dries slowly (a real drawback in a heavy-monsoon hill site, so pair the sale with a blanket khol). Also the standard donation/seva item for a Trust campus; keep a bale rate ready.

skuLines.line: Polar fleece blanket / throw — single, lightweight
skuLines.examples: Purav Light fleece single 220 GSM, plain polar fleece 60x90, Cloth Fusion AC fleece, Story@Home fleece throw
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 140-700 (Amazon: min 138, p25 280, median 328)
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar, plus bus/travel demand at every term break
skuLines.notes: The cheapest way a student gets warm — impulse price point, dries fast (the monsoon advantage over wool), packs into a bag for the journey home. Best margin in the warmth block.

skuLines.line: Sherpa / flannel heavy blanket — 600+ GSM reversible
skuLines.examples: Cloth Fusion sherpa fleece 640 GSM, BSB HOME flannel-sherpa reversible, HOMEKART 520 GSM, BSB 600 GSM plush sherpa
skuLines.seasonality: Nov-Jan deep winter
skuLines.notes: The 2026 replacement for the traditional woollen blanket at the mid-premium end; visibly plush, so it sells on touch. Hold 2-3 colours only — high ticket, high cube.

skuLines.line: Cotton-filled razai / winter quilt (local, 3-5 kg fill)
skuLines.examples: Locally stitched razai from Rajgarh/Solan pinjai, Jaipuri cotton razai, Swayam Winter Quilt, Spaces Quilt Double
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 800-2,500 local; Rs 3,600-5,900 branded (Swayam/Spaces winter quilt: p25 4,199, max 5,919)
skuLines.seasonality: Sep-Dec only; dead stock by February
skuLines.notes: Source locally-stitched rather than branded — freight on a 5 kg quilt from Panipat destroys the margin, and a local pinjai can also refill customers' old quilts (see adjacent services). Bought once every 4-6 years per household, so depth should be low and the khol/cover attach rate high.

skuLines.line: Microfibre comforter — single and double, 200-600 GSM
skuLines.examples: ALISHIBA CASA 600 GSM heavy winter comforter, SleepyCat all-season reversible, AYKA 150 GSM AC comforter, Story@Home Double Comforter
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb for 400-600 GSM; Mar-Sep for 150-250 GSM 'AC' weights
skuLines.notes: Lighter and faster-drying than a cotton razai, which matters in a damp hill winter; the same SKU family covers both seasons if you split on GSM. Machine-washable is the stated reason buyers switch.

skuLines.line: AC quilt / dohar — cotton malmal, single and double
skuLines.examples: Mafatlal Sparsh 150 GSM malmal dohar, haus & kinder cotton dohar, Swayam AC Quilt, Story@Home Single/Double Dohar
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 350-1,000 mass (Amazon median 629); Rs 1,900-4,400 branded (Swayam AC-quilt/dohar: p25 2,269, median 2,589)
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Sep peak, but sells as a light winter under-layer too
skuLines.notes: No longer a niche: 420 dohar + 366 'AC Quilt' SKUs across the four catalogues pulled — the largest single block on Swayam. In a hill site it works nine months of the year, which makes it a better stock-turn bet than a razai.

skuLines.line: Khes / cotton chaddar (handloom, Solapur/Panipat)
skuLines.examples: Arvore Bunkaar handloom desi khes, Tharunsha Solapur chaddar 3-pack, Panipat cotton khes
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 350-900 (Amazon: p25 499, median 645)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavier use Oct-Mar
skuLines.notes: The traditional Punjabi/Himachali layer older residents actually ask for — cheap, indestructible, washes and dries in a day. Also the standard extra layer issued to hostel students; sells well in 2- and 3-piece packs.

skuLines.line: Weighted blanket — 3-11 kg, glass-bead fill
skuLines.examples: Mysa Sleep 11 kg cooling weighted blanket, Mysa 3.5 kg kids, Tencel-cover weighted blankets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, marketed as sleep/anxiety aid
skuLines.notes: Newly mainstream on Indian e-com in 2025-26. One or two display pieces only; a residential campus with exam-stress and special-needs students is exactly the population that buys it, but it is a considered, once-ever purchase.

skuLines.line: Electric blanket / bed warmer — single and double
skuLines.examples: Bell electric blanket single (ZED certified), Beurer UB 56 double, Heatronics hCore single
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Jan; near-zero the rest of the year
skuLines.notes: The one electrical item that belongs in a cold-climate furnishing bay. Insist on BIS/ZED-marked stock and keep the warranty card — an electrical fault in an institutional hostel is a serious liability. Elderly residents and married quarters are the buyers, not students in shared rooms.

skuLines.line: Hot water bottle / rubber hot-water bag with plush cover
skuLines.examples: ANTIL'S 2 L rubber hot water bag, Tata 1mg 2 L heating bag, Nuvex 1 L with plush cover
skuLines.packSizes: 1 L and 2 L; with or without cover
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-350 (Amazon: p25 189, median 199)
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar, and every month for period pain
skuLines.notes: Cheap, high-repeat (rubber perishes in a season or two), and the item a resident absolutely will not drive 40 km for — which is why running out of it is a pure lost sale. Stock the cover separately too.

skuLines.line: Baby blanket / swaddle wrap / hooded fleece wrapper
skuLines.examples: OYO BABY swaddle wrap with hood and booties, Butterthief sherpa swaddle, Florida flannel baby blanket, haus & kinder muslin wrap
skuLines.packSizes: 100x140 cm blanket; 0-6 m and 6-24 m wraps
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 250-1,000 (Amazon: p25 294, median 486)
skuLines.seasonality: Winter peak; steady birth-driven demand year-round
skuLines.notes: Married staff with infants have no alternative source at all — no q-commerce serves this PIN. Small, light, high margin, and gifted constantly between families on campus. Keep both fleece (winter) and muslin (monsoon/summer) versions.

skuLines.line: Sleeping bag — 150-280 GSM, hooded
skuLines.examples: Lifelong sleeping bag 4-10 degC, Montaray Outsite 150, Montaray Horizon 280 waterproof
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 1,000-1,700 (Amazon: median 1,289)
skuLines.seasonality: School trek/camp season and NCC/Scouts camps
skuLines.notes: Justified only because this is a Himachal residential school that runs treks and camps, and because visiting parents/relatives overflow into floor sleeping. 2-3 pieces, or take it on indent.

skuLines.line: Fibre pillow — standard 16x24, hollow/microfibre fill
skuLines.examples: MY ARMOR height-adjustable microfibre set of 2, DALUCI hollow fibre 27x16, generic hollow-fibre 16x24
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 190-700 per piece (Amazon pack-of-2 median 474, i.e. ~Rs 250/pc)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake spike; year-round replacement
skuLines.notes: A hostel pillow flattens in a year, so this repeats far faster than the buyer expects. Very bulky per rupee — negotiate compressed/vacuum-packed inward from the mill, otherwise you pay to freight air up the hill.

skuLines.line: Premium pillow — memory foam / microfibre branded
skuLines.examples: The Sleep Company SmartGRID pillow, AYKA bamboo microfibre set of 2, GADDA CO zip fibre pillow, Sleepyhead memory foam
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 1,000-3,400 (four-catalogue pillow band: p25 1,499, median 1,999, p90 3,399)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Sells on a neck/back-pain conversation, not on price — mostly to faculty and elderly residents. 3-4 pieces on display; anything deeper is dead capital.

skuLines.line: Baby pillow (rai/mustard-seed) and baby gadda/bedding set
skuLines.examples: Mustard-seed baby pillow, cotton baby gadda with pillow and bolsters, OYO BABY baby bedding set, crib bedding set
skuLines.packSizes: Baby pillow 9x12 in; gadda set 24x36 in with 2 side bolsters
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 200-900 pillow; Rs 700-2,000 gadda set
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gifted at births and naming ceremonies
skuLines.notes: The traditional rai pillow is what grandmothers on campus ask for by name; keep it alongside the modern flat baby pillow. Cotton fill mildews in the monsoon — store off the floor and rotate stock.

skuLines.line: Pillow protector — waterproof / dust-proof, zipped
skuLines.examples: MY ARMOR waterproof pillow protector set of 2, Trance terry zippered protector, AYKA 220 GSM quilted protector
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 200-500 per pair (Amazon: p25 299, median 399)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; attaches to every pillow sale
skuLines.notes: Pure attach-sale: offer it with every pillow and every mattress-protector purchase. In a damp climate it is also what keeps a fibre pillow from going musty.

skuLines.line: Mattress protector — waterproof fitted, single and double
skuLines.examples: Trance 100% waterproof king 78x72, terry-TPU knitted protector, AYKA quilted waterproof king, Spaces mattress protector
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 360-900 mass (Amazon: p25 559, median 669); Rs 1,500-2,700 quilted/branded
skuLines.seasonality: Intake months and monsoon (damp mattresses)
skuLines.notes: In a boarding school this is not a nicety: junior-wing bedwetting, sick-bay beds and monsoon damp all destroy hostel mattresses, and a Rs 600 protector saves a Rs 3,000 mattress. Sell it as part of the admission kit. TPU-backed knitted terry is the current mass standard.

skuLines.line: Baby dry sheet / waterproof bed protector (S/M/L)
skuLines.examples: Luvlap Instadry medium, OYO BABY anti-pilling fleece dry sheet, Bumpers quick-dry sheet, Cherilo 3-pack
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 170-400 (Amazon: p25 208, median 274)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; more in monsoon when nothing dries
skuLines.notes: Highest-repeat baby furnishing item; married staff buy 3-4 at a time because a wet one takes two days to dry in a hill monsoon. Absolutely must not stock out — the alternative is a 40 km drive with an infant.

skuLines.line: Adult washable underpad / bed protector for elderly care
skuLines.examples: Washable 3-layer underpad 90x60, Solimo disposable underpads 40s, Dr Trust reusable bed pad
skuLines.packSizes: Washable single pieces 70x90 / 90x120 cm; disposable packs of 10/40
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 450-1,000 washable (Amazon median ~939); Rs 600 per 40-pack disposable
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: A township with resident elderly and a sick bay needs this, and nobody stocks it locally — it is the most dignity-critical gap in the lane. Keep it low-key on the shelf, near mattress protectors rather than near baby goods.

skuLines.line: Mattress cover / gadda khol — zipped cotton
skuLines.examples: Pure cotton zipped mattress cover KD, local stitched gadda khol, Trance cotton zippered encasement
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-700 (Amazon cotton zipped from Rs 499)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake and post-monsoon refresh
skuLines.notes: Different product from the waterproof protector and both sell: the khol keeps a hostel mattress from shedding and can be stitched locally to the exact 3x6 hostel size — a stitching tie-up beats importing sizes that never fit.

skuLines.line: Foldable cotton gadda / floor mattress — single
skuLines.examples: NEXTGO single cotton mattress 3x6.5 ft foldable with pillow, cotton-filled quilt gadda, SleepyCat tri-fold
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 1,000-2,500 local cotton (Amazon median 998-2,073); Rs 5,400 branded tri-fold
skuLines.seasonality: Parents' visiting days, convocation, winter guests
skuLines.notes: The extra-guest bed for staff quarters and hostel guest rooms — a campus with visiting-parent weekends needs floor bedding on tap. Bulky: hold few, and pair with the rental idea in adjacent services.

skuLines.line: Foam mattress — single 3x6, 4-5 inch
skuLines.examples: Sleepwell/Kurlon single 4 in, Livpure ortho single, Wakefit 5 in single, local rebonded-foam single
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 2,500-6,000 (Amazon single-mattress band: p25 899 for thin pads, real 4-5 in stock 3,500-5,400)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake and quarter-allotment months
skuLines.notes: Carry on indent, not on shelf — worst cube-to-rupee ratio in the store and a hill truck fits very few. But it is a real leak: a family that drives to Solan for a mattress buys their sheets, pillows and curtains there too.

skuLines.line: Bath towel — mass cotton/microfibre, 400-500 GSM large
skuLines.examples: Fezora microfibre 70x140 400 GSM, Story@Home Men/Ladies bath towel, Swayam cotton bath towel, Bombay Dyeing 450 GSM
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 190-600 (Amazon: p25 298, median 388); Rs 798-1,399 branded (Spaces bath towel p25 798, median 999)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake spike; year-round replacement
skuLines.notes: Core repeat line. In a monsoon hill climate the deciding attribute is drying speed, not plushness — a 600 GSM cotton towel never dries between Jul and Sep, which is why microfibre and mid-GSM cotton outsell heavy cotton here.

skuLines.line: Bath towel — premium 600+ GSM cotton / bamboo
skuLines.examples: Spaces Hygro 600 GSM, Earthy Fables bamboo 600 GSM, Mush bamboo towel, HUPLA hotel-grade 730 g
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 700-2,000 (Amazon premium: 1,298-1,999; four-catalogue towel p75 1,299)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali gifting Oct-Nov; wedding gifting
skuLines.notes: Mainly a gifting SKU on a campus — boxed towel sets move at Diwali and at teacher farewells. Bamboo/'hygro' is the 2026 premium claim (98 hygro and 8 bamboo SKUs in the catalogues pulled).

skuLines.line: Quick-dry microfibre towel — hostel/gym/travel
skuLines.examples: Fezora microfibre quick-dry, generic 400 GSM microfibre gym towel, Heelium quick-dry
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon Jul-Sep is the true peak; also sports season
skuLines.notes: The honest answer to a hill monsoon: it dries overnight in an unheated hostel room where cotton does not. Merchandise it explicitly as 'dries in the monsoon' — that framing, not the price, is what sells it.

skuLines.line: Hand towels — packs of 2/4/6
skuLines.examples: AmazonBasics cotton hand towel 6-pack, Spaces Hand Towel, Story@Home hand towel set, Sulfar combed cotton set
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 90-560 per set (Amazon: min 92, p25 249, median 377); Rs 499-799 branded singles
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Institutional as well as household: hostels, classrooms, langar hall and offices all consume hand towels continuously. Multi-packs at a sharp price beat single pieces here.

skuLines.line: Face towels / napkins — packs of 6-12
skuLines.examples: Spaces Face Towel, Heelium bamboo face towel, cotton lunch-napkin 12-pack, baby muslin washcloths
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 105-450 per pack (Amazon: p25 225, median 299)
skuLines.seasonality: School-session start (lunch napkins are on the kit list)
skuLines.notes: Small, cheap, best margin per shelf-inch in the lane, and school kit lists mandate them — stock deep in white and in dark colours for boys' hostels.

skuLines.line: Bath robe / bath wrap
skuLines.examples: Spaces Bath Robe, Story@Home bathrobe, cotton terry wrap-around towel
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 800-2,000 (four-catalogue robe band: p25 999, median 1,369)
skuLines.seasonality: Winter; gifting
skuLines.notes: Genuinely useful in shared-bathroom hostels in a cold winter, but it is a slow, sized SKU — 4-6 pieces total, or skip in year one.

skuLines.line: Baby hooded towel
skuLines.examples: Cotton animal-hood baby towel, NINTARABABY organic muslin hooded towel, Mee Mee hooded towel
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 200-500 mass (Amazon: p25 301, median 413); Rs 999-1,139 organic muslin
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter emphasis
skuLines.notes: Standard newborn-gift item between campus families. Small footprint, reliable turn.

skuLines.line: Bath mat / anti-slip bathroom mat
skuLines.examples: Story@Home cotton bath mat, ishro anti-skid rubber mat, Freelance PVC anti-slip shower mat, Eurotex bathtub mat
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-500 (Amazon: p25 259, median 360)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; monsoon and winter (wet floors) peak
skuLines.notes: Safety line, not decor: cold wet stone floors plus elderly residents equals falls. Stock the rubber/PVC anti-skid version alongside the pretty cotton one and say plainly which is which.

skuLines.line: Door curtain 7 ft — pair, polyester room-darkening
skuLines.examples: Story@Home 7 ft door curtain set of 2, LOOMLYFE microfibre 48x84, polyester room-darkening pair, Swayam Curtains
skuLines.packSizes: Pack of 2, 4x7 ft (48x84 in); eyelet or tie-top
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 350-900 mass (Amazon: p25 409, median 563); Rs 899-1,598 branded (four-catalogue curtain p25 899, median 1,299)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali cleaning (Oct-Nov) and new-quarter allotment
skuLines.notes: Best margin of any large furnishing item, and a genuine cold-climate function: a heavy door curtain blocks the draught in an unheated hill room. Stock the two Indian standard drops (7 ft door, 5 ft window) and nothing exotic — sizes are the whole game.

skuLines.line: Window curtain 5 ft — pair
skuLines.examples: Story@Home window curtain set of 2 (4x5 ft), Swayam window curtain, polyester eyelet window pair
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-800 mass; Rs 699-1,299 branded
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali; term start for hostel rooms
skuLines.notes: Hostel and quarter windows are small — this size outsells the door drop. Sell with rods/hooks in the same trip or the customer comes back annoyed.

skuLines.line: Blackout / thermal insulated curtain
skuLines.examples: Thermal insulated room-darkening polyester pair, Story@Home blackout, triple-weave blackout 7 ft
skuLines.packSizes: Pack of 2, 5 ft and 7 ft drops
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb (heat retention) and Apr-Jun (light/heat blocking)
skuLines.notes: The one curtain worth an explicit cold-climate pitch: thermal-lined panels measurably cut night heat loss through single-glazed hill windows. Also sells to day-sleeping shift staff and to hostel wardens.

skuLines.line: Sheer / net curtain
skuLines.examples: Net fabric sheer pair, tissue/organza sheer 5 ft and 7 ft, Swayam sheer curtain
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali
skuLines.notes: Layered behind the main curtain in staff quarters; cheap, flat-packed, high margin. Two colours (white, cream) cover 90% of demand.

skuLines.line: Curtain hardware — rods, brackets, rings, hooks, clips, wire
skuLines.examples: Deco Essential adjustable iron rod, AmazonBasics 36-72 in rod, plastic curtain rings, S-hooks, tension wire
skuLines.packSizes: Rods 3-5 ft and extendable 5.5-10 ft; rings/hooks in 10s and 20s
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 210-1,300 rods (Amazon: p25 629, median 799); Rs 30-120 per hook/ring pack
skuLines.seasonality: Follows curtain sales exactly
skuLines.notes: Non-negotiable attach line: a curtain without a rod is a returned curtain. Cheap, dense, freight-friendly, and the fittings margin is better than the fabric margin. Keep a screwdriver/wall-plug pack next to it.

skuLines.line: Door mat — coir, rubber and PVC
skuLines.examples: Onlymat coir doormat with rubber backing, Story@Home Door Mat, Goodpecker PVC anti-slip hollow mat, Saral Home cotton-jute mat
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-800 (Amazon coir: p25 399, median 611; four-catalogue door mat median 599)
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon Jul-Sep is the peak (mud), plus Diwali
skuLines.notes: Heavy-monsoon hill campus means mud on every threshold — this is a seasonal volume item, not decor. Coir rots if it never dries; keep the PVC/rubber hollow mats for the wettest months and say why.

skuLines.line: Plastic chatai, tirpal and tadpatri sheeting
skuLines.examples: Multipurpose plastic floor mat chatai 4x6 ft, reversible plastic sitting mat, TUFFPAULIN 120 GSM tarpaulin, BENAVJI heavy-duty tarpaulin
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 130-400 chatai (Amazon median 283); Rs 200-900 tarpaulin (median 699)
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon Jun-Sep for tarpaulin; chatai year-round for floor seating and functions
skuLines.notes: Two jobs in one supplier: floor seating for functions and langar overflow, and waterproof covering when the monsoon hits stored goods, scooters and construction. Bulk-rolled, cheap to freight, no seasonality risk on the chatai half.

skuLines.line: Cotton durrie / dari — hall, langar and prayer seating
skuLines.examples: Handloom cotton durrie 6x9 ft, Saral Home cotton-jute woven dari, Panipat institutional dari, HOMADORN printed dhurrie
skuLines.packSizes: 3x5, 6x9 and 9x12 ft; institutional runs in bales
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 350-1,500 household (Amazon: p25 399, median 498); Rs 1,499+ handmade/large
skuLines.seasonality: Function and gurpurab calendar; winter floor-covering demand
skuLines.notes: A Sikh institutional campus seats large sangat on the floor — dari demand here is institutional-scale and utterly predictable from the gurpurab calendar. Ask the Trust for its function calendar and stock against it; cotton dari also mildews, so store raised and rotate.

skuLines.line: Carpet / rug / bedside runner
skuLines.examples: Braided jute floor carpet, printed cotton rug runner 2x5 ft, Story@Home Carpet, Eurotex bedside runner
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 500-2,000 (Amazon: p25 947, median 1,349); Rs 1,299-9,520 branded (Story@Home carpet band)
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Dec (cold floors + Diwali)
skuLines.notes: Cold stone floors in staff quarters make a bedside runner a comfort purchase, not decor. Keep to small sizes — a 5x7 rug is a freight and shelf-space problem for a store this size.

skuLines.line: Pooja / prayer asan mat
skuLines.examples: Woollen puja asan 20x22 in, korai-grass sitting mat, cotton asan, velvet asan
skuLines.packSizes: Single asan 18x18 to 20x22 in; sets of 2 and 4
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 90-450 (Amazon: p25 224, median 299)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gurpurabs and Amrit Vela paath
skuLines.notes: In a Sikh township, an individual seating asan for daily paath and for cold floors in the prayer room is a routine, repeat purchase — cheap, small, and stocked nowhere else within 30 km.

skuLines.line: Cushion covers and cushion fillers
skuLines.examples: Pinkparrot jacquard 16x16 set of 5, Swayam Cushion Cover, Story@Home cushion cover, hollow-fibre 16x16 filler
skuLines.packSizes: 16x16 and 18x18 in; covers in sets of 2 and 5; fillers singly
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-650 per set of 5 (Amazon: p25 349, median 469); Rs 499-1,099 branded sets; fillers Rs 120-250 each
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali; hostel-room setup at term start
skuLines.notes: The cheapest way a student or a young couple changes how a room looks — highest margin in soft decor. Always stock fillers: covers alone strand the sale.

skuLines.line: Sofa cover / sofa throw
skuLines.examples: Stretchable 3-seater sofa cover, HOKIPO frill sofa cover, Story@Home Sofa Cover and Sofa Throw, velvet stretch slipcover
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-1,000 (Amazon: p25 575, median 829); Rs 993-3,897 branded (Story@Home band)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali; new-quarter allotment
skuLines.notes: Staff quarters and guest rooms only. Sized SKU with real return risk — stock the stretch-fit 3-seater and the plain throw, skip the fitted-set variants.

skuLines.line: Table cover, table mats and runners — PVC and cloth
skuLines.examples: Freelance PVC transparent dining cover, Swayam Table Cover and Table Runner, Story@Home table mats set of 6
skuLines.packSizes: 4- and 6-seater covers 60x90 in; mats in 6s; runners 13x72 in
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 200-800 (Amazon: p25 329, median 399); Rs 409-1,569 branded (Swayam band)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali; year-round PVC replacement
skuLines.notes: The transparent PVC roll cover is the everyday seller (it wears out yearly); cloth runners are Diwali/gifting. Buying the PVC on the roll and cutting to size in-store lifts margin and removes size mismatches.

skuLines.line: Mosquito net — single and double, foldable machardani
skuLines.examples: Foldable polyester machardani 6x6 ft, pop-up tent-style double net, Classic 30 GSM king machardani, cot net for babies
skuLines.packSizes: Single 3x6, double 6x6 and 6.5x6.5 ft; pop-up and hanging types; baby-cot size
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-900 (Amazon: min 185, p25 423, median 599)
skuLines.seasonality: Jun-Sep monsoon peak
skuLines.notes: Monsoon in Sirmaur means mosquitoes and a dengue/malaria advisory season — nets sell as protection, not comfort, and the baby-cot version has no substitute. Foldable/pop-up types suit hostel beds where nothing can be nailed to the wall.

skuLines.line: Seasonal storage: quilt/blanket bags, under-bed bags, and moth protection
skuLines.examples: Denim/non-woven blanket storage bag with zip, vacuum compression bags, Presto naphthalene balls 1 kg, camphor and neem sachets
skuLines.packSizes: Storage bags 60-100 L; naphthalene 200 g x 5 and 1 kg; camphor holders
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-450 bags (Amazon: p25 238, median 279); Rs 70-350 naphthalene/camphor (median 249)
skuLines.seasonality: Twin peaks: Feb-Mar (packing woollens away) and Sep-Oct (taking them out)
skuLines.notes: In a damp hill climate, stored woollens mildew and get moth-eaten — this line exists because the blanket line exists. Merchandise it beside the blankets in Feb-Mar and you convert the end-of-season shopper twice. Naphthalene needs no licence but must be kept away from foodstuff and labelled; it is toxic if a child eats it.

skuLines.line: Indoor cloth drying stand, line, pegs and hangers
skuLines.examples: Robustt wall-mounted 45 ft drying stand, foldable floor drying rack, PUTHAK round hanger with 24 clips, nylon rope and plastic pegs, hanger 12-packs
skuLines.packSizes: Wall-mounted 4-6 rail; floor stands; pegs in 24s and 48s; hangers in 12s
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 300-2,500 stands (Amazon: median 1,798; wall-mount from 499); Rs 40-150 pegs/rope; Rs 150-300 hanger packs
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Sep monsoon and Dec-Jan (nothing dries outdoors)
skuLines.notes: The most under-appreciated must-have in a heavy-monsoon hill township: for three months, laundry only dries indoors. Sells to every cohort, from a hostel student's Rs 320 clip-hanger to a family's Rs 1,800 folding rack. Stock the cheap end deep.

skuLines.line: Laundry bag / hamper — hostel size
skuLines.examples: Zippered laundry bag 45 L, collapsible round hamper, mesh delicates bag, extra-large denim storage bag
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 150-450 (Amazon: p25 238, median 299)
skuLines.seasonality: Intake months; steady replacement
skuLines.notes: Every boarder needs one to get clothes to the campus laundry, and the school kit list usually says so. Cheap, packs flat, and stackable — a near-perfect hill-freight item. Add a name-tape or marker pen alongside; unnamed hostel laundry is the classic loss.

skuLines.line: Rumala Sahib and prayer-room textiles
skuLines.examples: Rumala Sahib sets (cotton/satin/embroidered), chanani/chandoa canopy cloth, palki cloth, white cotton sangat sheeting
skuLines.packSizes: Rumala sets (3-5 pc); canopy cloth by the metre; white sheeting in bolts
skuLines.priceBand: Rs 500-1,500 simple cotton sets; Rs 2,000-8,000 embroidered/satin (indicative — not price-verified in this research)
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurabs, Sangrand, Akhand Paath bookings, family remembrance days
skuLines.notes: Flagged deliberately: on a Kalgidhar Trust campus this is a real, recurring, respect-critical purchase that residents currently make on trips to Anandpur Sahib, Amritsar or Chandigarh. It may sit in a religious-articles lane rather than furnishing, but it is textile buying and should not fall between two stools. Handle with the correct protocol on storage and display; take guidance from the Trust before stocking, and price it as service, not margin.

trends2026: Fitted (all-round elastic) bedsheets have gone from niche to core — 345 of the 4,156 live SKUs pulled, and Spaces (Welspun) now runs 'Fitted Queen' and 'Fitted King' as their own product types. Ideal for thin hostel mattresses.

The 'AC quilt / dohar' has become a year-round category rather than a summer one: 420 dohar + 366 AC-quilt SKUs across four catalogues, the single largest block on Swayam, spanning Rs 350 mass to Rs 4,400 branded.

Cooling / temperature-regulating bedding has arrived at the premium end — The Sleep Company's SnowTec quilted sheets (10 SKUs live), Tencel-covered cooling weighted blankets, 'all-season reversible' comforters. Sleep-tech language is spilling from mattresses into linen.

Shoppers now buy on printed specs: 1,655 of the SKUs pulled carry a TC number in the title and 519 carry GSM. 500-525 GSM mink and 600 GSM 'heavy winter' comforters are the new cold-belt call-outs, and hill demand skews a full GSM tier above the plains.
Sherpa / flannel reversible heavy blankets (600-640 GSM, Rs 1,500-3,500) are displacing the traditional woollen blanket at the mid-premium end — they sell on touch and dry faster than wool.
Bamboo, 'hygro' and organic cotton claims are now standard in towels and sheets (98 hygro, 36 organic, 8 bamboo SKUs in the four catalogues; bamboo bath towels at Rs 1,000-2,000 on Amazon).
Weighted blankets have crossed into mainstream Indian e-commerce (Rs 2,000-7,000, kids' 3.5 kg versions included) — three years ago this was an import-only category.

The waterproof protection layer — mattress protector plus pillow protector — is becoming a default add-on rather than a hospital item, with TPU-backed knitted terry at Rs 500-700, and bundled 'bed in a bag' 4-8 piece sets (62 SKUs) doing the same job for gifting and hostel admission.
adjacentServices: Quilt re-filling / cotton carding (pinjai) — collect old razais in Feb-Mar, return refilled in Sep-Oct. A hill town's most-wanted furnishing service and it turns a once-in-five-years product into an annual revenue line.
Curtain and cover stitching / alteration — hem to the exact window drop, stitch mattress khols and gadda covers to hostel 3x6 sizes. Removes the size-mismatch returns that plague readymade curtains.
Store-assembled hostel admission kit at a fixed price (sheet + pillow + cover + protector + towel + laundry bag), pre-booked with the admission letter and delivered to the hostel block.
Name-taping / monogramming of hostel linen and towels — small charge, near-zero cost, and it solves the school's biggest laundry-loss complaint.
Curtain rod and drying-rack fitting (drill, plugs, brackets) — a Rs 100-200 fitting charge that also unlocks sales to residents with no tools.
Bedding rental for visiting parents and convocation guests — foldable gaddas, quilts and pillows out and back, laundered in between. Uses the same stock twice.
Blanket, quilt and curtain laundry / dry-clean drop point — a collection counter tied to a Solan or Nahan cleaner, with a weekly run.
Seasonal storage: sell the vacuum bag and moth balls at the Feb changeover, and offer paid off-site storage of bulky winter bedding for hostel students going home.

Institutional rate card and indent desk for the Trust — hostels, guest houses, sick bay and langar hall buy plain bedsheets, dari, blankets and towels in bales; a standing quote captures spend that otherwise goes to Chandigarh wholesalers.
Term-end buy-back / exchange on blankets and mattresses from departing students, refurbished and resold to the next intake.

HONEST LIMITATION: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task began, so no WebSearch was possible. DuckDuckGo served a CAPTCHA, Bing returned off-topic results for shopping queries, and IndiaMART (429), Meesho (403), Blinkit, Zepto, DMart and JioMart all blocked or returned unparseable SPA shells — so BigBasket/Blinkit/Zepto/DMart/Reliance Smart category pages and 2026 trend articles could NOT be read directly. The trends listed are therefore derived from evidence in the live catalogues pulled (product-type names, GSM/TC claim frequency, SKU counts) plus model knowledge to May 2026, not from 2026 trend journalism.

HONEST LIMITATION: every priceBand is observed live (Aug-2026) and traceable to the sources above, EXCEPT the Rumala Sahib line, which is marked as indicative. Every marginBand is an industry-typical estimate for Indian retail, NOT measured — no margin data was retrieved in this research, and ARY's own landed costs will move these by 5-15 points, more once hill freight on bulky goods (blankets, quilts, mattresses, pillows) is loaded in.
